_note: Publish-ready destination content for the data-driven page system. Facts are from the current homepage. Copy is written in the Limitless captain-and-crew voice (British English). trip_type indicates whether the route fits a half-day, full day, or multi-day charter. Times/distances are from Club de Mar, Palma. Prices are never hard-coded here — pages should link to the quote/availability flow.

destinations.name: Portals Vells
destinations.meta_title: Portals Vells by Boat — Sea Caves & Turquoise Coves | Limitless Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Portals Vells from Club de Mar — sheltered turquoise bays and the famous sea caves, just 35 minutes from Palma. Crewed Maiora, up to 12 guests.
destinations.h1: Portals Vells — sea caves and turquoise coves
destinations.tagline: The easy first bay — clear water and cool sea caves, barely half an hour from the marina.
destinations.intro: Twenty minutes past the marinas of the southwest and the coast softens into a run of shallow, impossibly clear bays. Portals Vells is the one nearly everyone loves first: sheltered, sandy-bottomed and calm, with the old stone sea caves carved into the headland at one end.
destinations.body: It is the shortest hop we make — around 35 minutes from Club de Mar — which makes it the perfect anchor for a half-day. Swim straight off the swim platform into water you can see your toes in, take the tender or a paddleboard across to the caves, and let the crew handle the rest. Because it is so close, there is no rush: a morning here and lunch on board, or a lazy afternoon and a swim as the light goes gold.
highlights: Some of the clearest, calmest water near Palma
The historic sea caves at the point
Sandy bottom, easy for first-time swimmers and children
Close enough for a relaxed half-day

destinations.name: El Toro & Illes Malgrats
destinations.meta_title: El Toro & Illes Malgrats — Snorkelling Boat Trip | Limitless Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to the Illes Malgrats marine reserve off El Toro — the best snorkelling near Palma, 40 minutes from Club de Mar. Crewed yacht, snorkel gear on board.
destinations.h1: El Toro & Illes Malgrats — the marine reserve
destinations.tagline: Two protected islets and the best snorkelling within easy reach of Palma.
destinations.intro: Just off the El Toro headland lie the Illes Malgrats, a pair of low, rocky islets ringed by a marine reserve. Protection means fish — plenty of them — and water clear enough to watch the seabed drop away beneath the boat.
destinations.body: It is our go-to for anyone who wants to actually see something underwater. We anchor in the lee of the islands, hand out the snorkel sets, and the reserve does the rest. The Seabob and paddleboards come out here too. At around 40 minutes each way it sits comfortably inside a half-day, with time to move on to a quieter cove for lunch if the group wants a second stop.
highlights: Marine reserve — rich, easy snorkelling
Sheltered anchorage in most conditions
Snorkel sets, Seabob and SUP on board
Pairs well with a second cove for lunch

destinations.name: Cala Llamp
destinations.meta_title: Cala Llamp by Boat — Sheltered & Serene | Limitless Yacht Charter Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Cala Llamp near Port d'Andratx — a calm, deep-blue cove under the cliffs, an hour from Palma. Crewed Maiora, up to 12 guests.
destinations.tagline: Deep blue water under the cliffs near Port d'Andratx, away from the crowds.
destinations.intro: Tucked below the villas of Port d'Andratx, Cala Llamp is the quieter, more grown-up cove of the southwest — deep, still water the colour of ink and glass, framed by pine and rock.
destinations.body: There is no beach to speak of, which is precisely the point: you swim off the boat into water that stays calm when the wind gets up elsewhere. It is a favourite for groups who want somewhere serene to spend the middle of the day, roughly an hour from the marina. A long lunch, a swim, the tender ashore for a drink at one of the cliffside clubs if the mood takes you.
highlights: Calm, deep water when the southwest is breezy
Quieter and more private than the sandy bays
Cliffside beach clubs a tender-ride away
An easy full afternoon or long half-day

destinations.name: Sa Dragonera & Sant Elm
destinations.meta_title: Sa Dragonera & Sant Elm by Boat — Island Nature Reserve | Limitless Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Sa Dragonera, the uninhabited dragon island off Sant Elm — a protected natural park an hour from Palma. Crewed yacht day charter, up to 12 guests.
destinations.h1: Sa Dragonera & Sant Elm — the dragon island
destinations.tagline: An uninhabited island reserve at the western tip of Mallorca, all cliffs and clear channels.
destinations.intro: Sa Dragonera lies off the western tip of the island like a sleeping dragon — uninhabited, protected, and wild in a way the busy southern coves are not. The narrow channel between the island and Sant Elm holds some of the clearest water in Mallorca.
destinations.body: As a natural park it is buoys-only, which keeps it quiet and pristine. We make it a full day: cruise up the coast, pick up a mooring in the channel, swim and snorkel in the crystal water, and take the tender across to Sant Elm for lunch ashore or eat on board looking back at the island. About an hour and ten each way, so there is plenty of the day left to enjoy once you arrive.
highlights: Protected natural park — genuinely wild
Exceptionally clear water in the channel
Sant Elm a short tender-ride for lunch
A proper full-day cruise up the west coast

destinations.name: Cala Pi
destinations.meta_title: Cala Pi by Boat — Sheltered Cliffs & Fine Sand | Limitless Yacht Charter Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Cala Pi on Mallorca's south coast — a dramatic cliff-lined inlet with fine sand, an hour from Palma. Crewed Maiora day charter.
destinations.h1: Cala Pi — sheltered cliffs and fine sand
destinations.tagline: A dramatic sliver of a cove cut deep into the southern cliffs.
destinations.intro: Cala Pi is a proper hidden inlet — a narrow slot in the south-coast cliffs opening onto a wedge of fine, pale sand and turquoise shallows. From the water it is far more impressive than any photo taken from the clifftop above.
destinations.body: The cliffs give it real shelter, and the shallow, sandy entrance turns the water an unreal blue. We anchor off the mouth of the inlet, swim in towards the beach, and let the group drift between the boat and the sand. Around an hour and five each way makes it an easy, unhurried full day on the quieter southern coast.
highlights: Dramatic cliff-lined inlet, best seen from the sea
Fine sand and bright turquoise shallows
Well sheltered from most summer breezes
Quieter south-coast alternative to the busy southwest

destinations.name: Es Trenc
destinations.meta_title: Es Trenc by Boat — Mallorca's Caribbean-White Sand | Limitless Yacht Charter
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Es Trenc — Mallorca's longest wild white-sand beach and its famous turquoise water, reached by yacht from Palma. Crewed Maiora, up to 12 guests.
destinations.tagline: The island's most famous stretch of wild, white sand and unreal turquoise water.
destinations.intro: Es Trenc is the one people picture when they imagine Mallorca from a postcard — a long, undeveloped run of Caribbean-white sand backed by dunes, with shallow water that turns every shade of turquoise and jade.
destinations.body: Because it is protected from building, the beach stays wild, and the best of it is only really reachable comfortably by boat. We anchor off the sand in the shallows, and the whole group can float, swim and paddle in warm, waist-deep water for as far as you like. At around an hour and a half each way it is a classic full-day run down the south coast — bring nothing but a swimsuit and let the crew handle lunch.
highlights: Mallorca's most famous white-sand beach
Shallow, warm, endlessly turquoise water
Wild and undeveloped — best from the water
A signature full-day charter

destinations.name: Cabrera National Park
destinations.notes: National park — permit held · buoys only
destinations.meta_title: Yacht Charter to Cabrera National Park | Limitless Mallorca
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Cabrera, Mallorca's protected marine national park — turquoise coves, the Blue Cave and rich sea life. Permit held. Crewed Maiora day charter from Palma.
destinations.tagline: Mallorca's protected archipelago — a marine national park most people never reach.
destinations.intro: South of Mallorca, past the last of the coves, lies Cabrera: a small archipelago given over entirely to a marine and land national park. Access is limited and permit-controlled, which is exactly why it has stayed so unspoilt — clear water, healthy sea life and a stillness the mainland coves lost long ago.
destinations.body: We hold the permit, so the paperwork is ours to worry about, not yours. The day is built around the crossing — around an hour and forty each way — and the reward is a protected anchorage in the main harbour, the famous Blue Cave to explore by tender, and snorkelling in water that shows exactly why the park exists. It is a long, memorable full day; on calm settled weather it is one of the finest things you can do from Palma. Message the crew early, as park moorings are limited.
highlights: A protected marine national park — genuinely rare
Permit held by us — no admin for you
The Blue Cave and pristine snorkelling
One of the standout full-day charters from Palma

destinations.name: Caló des Moro & Cala Figuera
destinations.meta_title: Caló des Moro by Boat — Mallorca's Most Photographed Cove | Limitless
destinations.meta_description: Charter to Caló des Moro and Cala Figuera on Mallorca's southeast coast — the island's most photographed cove, best seen and swum from the water. Crewed Maiora.
destinations.h1: Caló des Moro & Cala Figuera — the photographed coves
destinations.tagline: The most photographed cove in Mallorca — and far better from the water than the queue on the cliff.
destinations.intro: Caló des Moro is the tiny, perfect cove you have seen a hundred times online: a scoop of white sand between steep pine-clad cliffs, water the colour of a swimming pool. From the clifftop it means a scramble and a crowd. From the sea, it is yours to swim into.
destinations.body: The neighbouring Cala Figuera is just as lovely and quieter still. This is a longer run — around two hours and ten each way to the southeast corner — so it works best as a full, early-start day, and it rewards the effort. We anchor off the cove, swim in past the cliffs, and you experience the famous spot the way almost no one else does: from the water, without the climb. Best on calm days; the crew will steer the day by the forecast.
highlights: Mallorca's most photographed cove, seen from the sea
Quieter neighbour Cala Figuera alongside
No clifftop scramble, no crowd
A rewarding long full-day run southeast

destinations.name: West Coast — Sa Foradada, Port de Sóller & Cala Tuent
destinations.meta_title: Northwest Coast Yacht Charter — Sa Foradada, Sóller, Cala Tuent | Limitless
destinations.meta_description: Explore Mallorca's dramatic Tramuntana coast by yacht — Sa Foradada, Port de Sóller and Cala Tuent beneath the mountains. Multi-day crewed charter from Palma.
destinations.h1: The northwest coast — mountains meeting the sea
destinations.tagline: The wild Tramuntana side of the island — cliffs, mountain villages and deep, cold-blue water.
destinations.intro: The northwest is the Mallorca most day-charters never see: the Serra de Tramuntana falling straight into the sea, the pierced rock of Sa Foradada, the harbour of Port de Sóller and the remote pebble cove of Cala Tuent beneath the highest peaks.
destinations.body: It is too far and too good to rush, so we treat it as an overnight or multi-day cruise rather than a dash. Anchor beneath Sa Foradada for lunch and a swim, take a mooring in Sóller's round bay for the evening, and wake somewhere spectacular. The scenery is on a different scale to the south — this is the trip for guests who have done the coves and want the grand version. The crew will map anchorages, mileage and running costs honestly for your dates.
highlights: The dramatic Tramuntana mountain coast
Sa Foradada, Port de Sóller and Cala Tuent
Best as an overnight or multi-day cruise
Scenery on a completely different scale

destinations.name: Mallorca Circumnavigation
destinations.meta_title: Sail Around Mallorca — Full Island Circumnavigation by Yacht | Limitless
destinations.meta_description: Circumnavigate Mallorca by private yacht — the complete 200 nm loop over 5–7 days, coves, mountains and quiet anchorages. Crewed Maiora, up to 7 overnight guests.
destinations.tagline: The complete island, coast to coast, at your own pace over several days.
destinations.intro: Mallorca is far more varied than any single day can show: the turquoise shallows of the south, the wild Tramuntana in the northwest, the quiet coves of the east. The circumnavigation strings them all together into one unhurried loop.
destinations.body: It is roughly 200 nautical miles — about twelve and a half hours of actual cruising — so we recommend five to seven days to do it justice, sleeping aboard and waking in a new bay each morning. You set the pace; the crew shapes each day around the weather and what you feel like. Provisioning, mooring and fuel on a trip this length run through an APA (advance provisioning allowance) with a transparent running tally, so there are no surprises at the end. The best way to see the whole island.
highlights: Every coast of Mallorca in one trip
5–7 days, sleeping aboard, new bay each morning
Entirely your pace and your route
Transparent APA — running costs tallied openly

destinations.name: Ibiza & Formentera
destinations.meta_title: Yacht Charter to Ibiza & Formentera from Mallorca | Limitless
destinations.meta_description: Cross from Mallorca to Ibiza and Formentera by private yacht — the white isle and Formentera's turquoise sandbanks. Multi-day crewed charter, up to 7 overnight.
destinations.h1: Ibiza & Formentera — the white isle crossing
destinations.tagline: Cross to the Pityusic islands — Ibiza's energy and Formentera's Caribbean sandbanks.
destinations.intro: West of Mallorca lie Ibiza and, just beyond it, Formentera — the pair that draw everyone eventually. Ibiza for its glamour, its anchorages and its evenings; Formentera for water so shallow and clear over white sand that it looks tropical.
destinations.body: The crossing is around four and a half hours, so this is firmly a multi-day trip: cross with settled weather, spend your days on Formentera's sandbanks and your evenings off Ibiza, and come back when the wind is right. We can take a marina berth or hang on anchor depending on what the group wants. As with any longer cruise, the crew will lay out distances, fuel, mooring and the APA clearly for your dates before you commit — nothing held back.
highlights: Formentera's famous turquoise sandbanks
Ibiza's anchorages and evenings
A multi-day crossing with settled weather
Marina or anchorage — your call

destinations.name: Menorca Crossing
destinations.meta_title: Yacht Charter to Menorca from Mallorca | Limitless
destinations.meta_description: Cross to Menorca by private yacht — wild unspoilt coves and the great natural harbour of Maó. Multi-day crewed charter from Mallorca, up to 7 overnight guests.
destinations.tagline: The quiet Balearic — untouched coves and one of the world's great natural harbours.
destinations.intro: Menorca is the Balearic that time forgot, in the best way: a biosphere reserve of undeveloped coves, pale sand and prehistoric shores, with far fewer boats than its noisier neighbours.
destinations.body: The crossing is a little under four hours, making it a rewarding multi-day escape for guests who want somewhere genuinely quiet. Work your way along the south coast's string of wild calas, drop into the vast natural harbour of Maó, and swim in water that stays empty even in August. Distances, fuel, mooring and the APA are mapped out honestly for your dates — the crew would rather over-explain the costs than surprise you.
highlights: Menorca's wild, undeveloped south-coast calas
The great natural harbour of Maó
Far quieter than Ibiza or the Mallorca coves
A relaxed multi-day crossing
